name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: Gene Munster (@munster_gene) says the Roadster event illustrates why Elon wants to combine $TSLA and $SPCX, as the new Roadster is a mashup of the two tech teams aiming to break physics with 0-60 in one second, high-G cornering, and 10 thrusters.
en_summary: Gene Munster (@munster_gene) says the Roadster event illustrates why Elon wants to combine $TSLA and $SPCX, as the new Roadster is a mashup of the two tech teams aiming to break physics with 0-60 in one second, high-G cornering, and 10 thrusters.
text:
The Roadster event is the latest example of why Elon can’t wait to bring $TSLA and $SPCX together.

Elon says the new Roadster is a mashup of the two tech teams.

The car’s goal is to break the laws of physics: 0-60 in one second, suck the road for high-G cornering, and 10 thrusters that cause the car to flip. It’s a ridiculous display of engineering.
